pages.text: Start with Andesite Alloy, shafts and a water wheel. Connect a small machine setup and use Create’s Ponder scenes to learn how components work.$(br2)Rotation must reach the machine, and the network must have enough capacity for the connected load. If machinery becomes overstressed, inspect the network and reduce the load or expand generation.
Use speed and stress information to understand what the machinery is doing. Changing speed affects the demands on the system.
